extraBlocks.markdown: Not applicable. The notes contain enough information to build the preparation sheet, so the full sheet follows below.

agenda.goal: Confirm the kick-off purpose and your open questions
Show the HR chatbot idea and the predictive maintenance idea, with one slide or sketch each
Hear which direction the supervisor thinks is feasible and what they would change
Agree on what is needed before the next meeting and when it happens

questions.text: Which of the two topic ideas do you think is more suitable for a bachelor thesis, and what would you change in it?
questions.fromNotes: "HR chatbot for onboarding OR predictive maintenance for a lift company"

questions.text: The predictive maintenance idea depends on a client that is not confirmed yet. How should we proceed while the client is open?
The idea of comparing two LLMs came up. Is that a direction you would consider, and how would it relate to the two topics?
What do you expect from the pitch at the kick-off, and how long should it be?
questions.fromNotes: "supervisor said 'be ready to pitch' - what even goes in a pitch?? 5 slides?"

questions.text: The notes mention a Python preference and no cloud use. Are these constraints workable for the topics you are considering?
How many meetings can we expect during the thesis?
questions.fromNotes: "also how many meetings will we even have"
